theorems.name: Submission.rsd_mw_wlm_exists_open_measure_between
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (W : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < R.measure W → ∃ V : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen V ∧ V ⊆ W ∧ c < R.measure V ∧ R.measure V < ∞
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
